One medium issue: [FunderSummary.svelte:157](/Users/jamie/development/exposed-funder-summary/frontend/src/FunderSummary.svelte:157) introduces a scrolling legend without handling its scroll events. Element scroll does not bubble to the existing window handler, so an open fixed tooltip can remain at its old position while its party row scrolls away. Hide or reposition it on legend scroll; test this separately from window scrolling.

Otherwise the diff preserves authoritative recipient ordering, exact amount formatting, member links and partial-data notes. All party controls remain present and keyboard reachable. The fixed legend height bounds variable labels and party counts. Mobile stacking and member timeline behavior remain intact.

Comment audit: no comments or suppressions added in the diff; zero deletions or `MUST KILL` flags. No edits or suites run. The reported 28 passing tests do not cover internal legend scrolling.
